perspective:
From Christian Mensah’s perspective, the information available to him is:

- He and Jonathan Balogun have been close friends since childhood. Christian often seeks Jonathan’s advice and values his perspective.
- Recently, Christian perceived Jonathan as acting differently. This made Christian anxious and suspicious that Jonathan was hiding something important from him.
- Christian arranged and attended a meeting with Jonathan at their favorite coffee shop.
- Christian told Jonathan he felt something serious was being hidden. He heard Jonathan admit he had been keeping something from him: Jonathan is in some trouble and did not know how to tell him.
- Christian felt worried and empathetic. He offered to help, saying they could face it together. He heard Jonathan say the situation is complicated, that he did not want to drag Christian into it, but that he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
- Christian came to believe Jonathan’s trouble might be related to criminal or illegal activity. He asked Jonathan directly.
- Christian heard Jonathan say he could not say for sure, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he did not do anything illegal himself. Jonathan said he trusted Christian to handle it carefully.
- Christian decided to look into the matter discreetly. His own investigation led him to believe/learn that Jonathan is being framed and that someone is trying to set him up. At that stage, Christian had leads but did not yet know who was responsible.
- Christian told Jonathan he believed Jonathan was being framed. He said he would gather more evidence to prove Jonathan’s innocence. Jonathan thanked him.
- Later, Christian concluded/claimed he had found out who was behind it: someone both he and Jonathan know and trust. Christian believed this was a betrayal by someone close to them.
- Christian decided to confront the real culprit and bring them to justice. He heard Jonathan warn that this person is dangerous and say that he trusts Christian to do what is right.
- The provided dialogue does not name the culprit to the reader, but Christian states that he has identified who it is.
